main_text.p: Huic literarum divisioni non inepte subjungi possunt.
main_text.head: Regulæ de investiganda radice;
main_text.p: 1. Si abjectis servilibus remanserint tres, ipsæ sunt radix.

2. Si duæ, quarum prior habet Daghes, tunc plerunque præponitur ו raro, ut ויגד[?] à ויגן[?] & ויצב[?] à יצב[?]. At in duobus, ut אקף[?] à קף[?] & לחע[?] à נחעו[?]. Sed in Chaldaicis posterior sæpe geminari debet, cum prior habet Daghes, ut infra patebit.

3. Si posterior fit Dagessata geminanda est, ut סבב[?] à סבב[?]. Sin verò Daghes fit characteristica Conjugationis Piel (quod ex forma vocis sciendum) tum postponendum ה, ut ילד[?] à ילד[?]. Excipiuntur etiam hæc nomina quæ cum affixis dagessantur, ira, ab אנף[?] filia, à בנה[?] & חטה[?] triticum, ab חנט[?].
4. Si duarum remanentium neutra fit dagessata, tum præponendum ꞏ vel ꞏ rarius א, vel interponendum[?], vel postponendum ה rarissimè א, aut ultima geminanda.

5. Si unica tantum remanserit, præpone ꞏvel ꞏ, & postpone ה: exceptis חיה[?] à ח[?]; & vocibus quibusdam præteriti à מות[?] mori, & שוה[?] ponere, quæ ה amittunt ante aliud ה: ut, שוה[?] posuisti, מת[?] mortuus es.

page.notes: Hebrew letters and vowel points are hard to read at this scan resolution; all Hebrew forms are best readings marked [?]. "interponendum" is printed with a doubtful letter (possibly a printing error for interponendum). Hyphen between "investiganda" and "radice" is a printed dash-like mark, rendered as a line break. Printed "sub-jungi" is joined as "subjungi". Long s rendered as s. No running head, no page-level damage beyond the faint lower-left edge.
